text:
kevin: quick sync  planning to flip the catalog to include hydra-10b-v2 in the next change window (Fri 03:00 UTC). want a clean pin + fallback plan before we toggle.
maria: ok. suggest we keep hydra-10b-v1 pinned for Dedicated for first 24h.
aj: agree. canary: 2% overall with region skew (eu 1.5%, us 0.5%). rollback thresholds: p99 latency +120ms, error rate >0.7%.
lina: ops request: add seq-len heatmap and kv-cache metrics to the canary dashboard.
kevin: noted. fallback ladder proposed: hydra-10b-v1 -> harbor-13b-quant -> llama-7b-legacy. auto-fallback on deploy errors or policy SLO breach.
sam: docs/marketing need a short blurb and a note about token-cost delta.
kevin: draft note: "hydra-10b-v2: improved grounding and ~10-15% token cost reduction under quant profiles; occasional memory spikes for <1% long-context invocations." comments?
aj: small tweak: add automatic rollback trigger for safety eval regressions (toxicity/coherence). telemetry-bot can flag.
telemetry-bot: safety snapshot created: run=run-2026-03-21-hydra; safety checks: basic pass. link: https://telemetry.internal/runs/run-2026-03-21-hydra
deploybot: queued command: `deploybot enable-model --model hydra-10b-v2 --canary 2% --regions eu,us --start 2026-03-26T03:00:00Z` (queued by kevin)
maria: ops pin command for Dedicated: `catalog pin --model hydra-10b-v1 --scope dedicated --ttl 24h`  please apply before start.
lina: I'll wire up the extra metrics to ops/boards/hydra-canary and add alerts for memory-spike and kv-degradation.
aj: I'll publish a short rollback playbook in the runbook repo and tag eng-oncall.
kevin: communication plan: if rollback occurs, post in #eng-releases and #eng-runtime: "Rollback: hydra-10b-v2 disabled; traffic restored to hydra-10b-v1; investigating." assign oncall to lead.
sam: add fallback ordering note to the release blurb so product knows how failsafe behaves.
kevin: added: "Fallback order: hydra-10b-v1 -> harbor-13b-quant -> llama-7b-legacy. Pins override auto ladders."
maria: last check: are canary safety tests green? any known regressions?
telemetry-bot: final safety evals complete. extended coherence and toxicity checks OK. perf snapshot: https://telemetry.internal/runs/run-2026-03-21-hydra/perf
deploybot: status update: job id=123456789 scheduled start=2026-03-26T03:00:00Z. will post at start and when canary finishes.
kevin: thanks everyone. react with :thumbsup: to approve. will proceed on schedule unless a blocker appears.
lina: :thumbsup:
maria: :thumbsup:
aj: :thumbsup:
sam: :thumbsup:
